name: Cathedral of the Deep
quote: Every prayer sinks eventually. Down here, we hear all of them.

civilopediaText.text: Raised by the Church of the Deep, this cathedral marks a place where surface faith and abyssal hunger meet. Congregants who pray here for long enough rarely stop - not because they choose to keep praying, but because something has started praying back.
A brood-pool built at the tideline, where the Many cultivate both food and future hosts from the same dark water.
